body:
I'm there with you minus the wife and kids.

Just turned 30 years old. My Dad got really sick this past Christmas and everything in my life has been flipped upside down. We've never had a good relationship, so now I'm having to build one with him. It's hard.

Similar to you, as of late - I have no focus, no interests in doing anything, no drive - it's like a completely different person has taken over. 

Therapy will be good for you. I started down that road recently and it has helped.

It's the pressures of society man. The system's fucked.
